prompt: Hibernate Envers revision number overflow negative exception type
answer:
`org.hibernate.envers.exception.AuditException`

The exception message is:

```text
Negative revision numbers are not allowed
```

It is thrown by `DefaultRevisionInfoGenerator.saveRevisionData()` when the revision number becomes negative, typically because an integer ID or database sequence overflows.
